name: a brain scan room: an MRI scanner with its sliding bed, a big wall screen that shows the scan, the operator's desk with a monitor, a tiled floor
fits: anything learnt from a brain or body scan: which parts of the brain work, the 10 percent myth, how a scan sees inside; the hero is the image on the wall screen
recipe: one back wall and a tiled floor slab, the scanner as a white iso box with a round bore on its front face and a bed that slides into it, the wall screen as a thin dark slab with the hero drawn on its face, a desk with legs and a monitor as dressing
